source.name: GNM Head v3
modifications: Synthetic male and female bald head presets with embedded skin and eye textures
Continuous brow and glabella surface refinement and interbrow pigment cleanup
Bound existing nose slider codes and alar width direction; added independent vertical tip-height blendshape; neutral geometry and textures unchanged
Embedded textures re-encoded as WebP (EXT_texture_webp, quality 90); geometry and metadata byte-identical (S15P31B204-555)

Added contour morph targets (cheekbone, chin projection/length/width, cheek volume, jaw angle) as sparse _neg/_pos pairs with services/gpu-worker/reconstruction/tools/contour_morphs.py; neutral geometry and textures unchanged
Added audited two-way relative face-shape targets to both synthetic samples; neutral geometry, textures, and existing targets unchanged
Reduced weight-shape displacement near mouth corners so combined edits keep the lip boundary clear; neutral geometry, textures, and other targets unchanged
Rebaked contour targets with mouth-line protection and final-mesh validation; neutral geometry, textures, nose and weight targets unchanged
